title: BEAT LOOP 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32
description: The six BEAT LOOP buttons set 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 and 32 beats, and their labels read so.

xdj700-v1.15.evidence: Rehearsed in emulation, both ways; not yet tested on hardware (docs/xdj700-flashing.md, stage 7).
limits: The lit pad follows the stock lengths: the pad to the right of the touched one lights, and the 32 pad lights none (in emulation; docs/xdj700-flashing.md, "The lit BEAT LOOP pad").
